cases.caption: A paint roller, dipped in green paint, is used to cover a section of a metal fence, creating a uniform green coat.
cases.first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: A paint roller, dipped in green paint, is used to cover a section of a metal fence, creating a uniform green coat. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: The paint roller must be fully saturated with green paint before application.
The roller must be rolled in a consistent, overlapping motion across the metal fence surface.
The paint must be applied evenly to ensure a uniform green coat without visible streaks or gaps.
The roller must be re-dipped in paint as needed to maintain consistent coverage during the process.

cases.caption: A wedge is driven into a log using a sledgehammer, splitting the log cleanly apart.
cases.first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: A wedge is driven into a log using a sledgehammer, splitting the log cleanly apart. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: The log must be positioned horizontally and stable on the ground for the wedge to be driven into it.
The wedge must be inserted at an angle into the log to create a split.
The sledgehammer must be used to strike the wedge repeatedly to deepen the split.
The log must be split cleanly apart as the wedge is driven further in.

settings.qwen_template: Given this initial image and the requested video, describe up to four short process requirements. Describe prerequisites, visible changes and continuation of existing results.
